consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity
authorisation of switching and access to apparatus

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: hazard report during routine operation on SG-9000

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on SG-9000 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically switching, racking and access authorisation. SG-9000 (mine switchgear) is in service for pit and workshop distribution. The task proceeded during routine operation while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 3 March 2012 a hazard report was recorded on SG-9000 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during routine operation; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
